name: nakastat
expr: [m_s, v_s] = nakastat(1, 1); [m_v, v_v] = nakastat([0.5 1 2], 1); [m_b, v_b] = nakastat(1, [0.5 1 2]); m_mu0 = nakastat(0, 1); m_om0 = nakastat(1, 0); m_mneg = nakastat(-1, 1);
comment: Sig: [m, v] = nakastat(mu, omega). Nakagami: m = sqrt(omega/mu)·Γ(mu+0.5)/Γ(mu), v = omega·(1 - r²/mu) where r = Γ(mu+0.5)/Γ(mu). Vectorised. mu<=0 / omega<=0 => NaN. MATLAB R2025b does not ship nakastat — Octave statistics package is the reference.
